source.title: Gone in 7 Days: the Google review deletion study
source.scope: Selected seven-sector panel in the US and Europe excluding the UK. No Canadian cohort. Deletion means absence from successive complete daily listings, not a verified reason or a provider outcome.
source.reuse: The public landing page authorises reuse of charts and numbers with credit to Reviewflowz and Cartelis and a link. Raw report, raw reviews and source artwork are not republished here.

policy.note: Directing review content, including requests that identify a staff member, is distinct from a customer independently naming a person. Other content/privacy rules can still apply. The study does not observe the request that produced a review.

limitations: Selected seven-sector panel in the US and Europe excluding the UK. No Canadian cohort. Deletion means absence from successive complete daily listings, not a verified reason or a provider outcome.

Review-level comparisons and business-level regressions are distinct estimands with overlapping source data. We do not pool them, run a new significance/equivalence test or infer causal effects. Source group-boundary labels are preserved without redefining exact endpoints.
Gains: preceding twelve months. Losses: observed two-week deletions scaled to a year. These are rounded group averages, not a fully observed annual cohort or cohort retention probability.
A person-name tag is not verified employment, proof of consent, or evidence of the preceding review request.
An interval containing one does not prove equivalence or no enforcement. Request behaviour is not observed.
Source estimates share underlying data; fifteen rows are not fifteen independent experiments.
The loss/gain ratio mixes historical gains with annualised short-window losses; do not call its complement a retention rate.
Request examples are original, constructed editorial examples, not sampled businesses, reviews or cases.
Original numbers are attributed to Reviewflowz and Cartelis. This release does not measure ReviewsBoost client outcomes.
